theorem.current: J_L=Z_{L-1}/Z_L for L>=1, and the injection, every bulk, and extraction currents agree.
theorem.dehp_weight: w(eta)=<W|prod_i(eta_i D+(1-eta_i)E)|V>, with DE=D+E and boundary eigenvectors
theorem.equal_rate_limit: When alpha=beta, each divided difference is (p+1) alpha^{-p}; this is the continuous alpha=beta limit.
theorem.finite_unique_stationary: For alpha>0 and beta>0 every finite L chain is irreducible and has one stationary law.
theorem.phase_diagram: LD alpha<min(beta,1/2); HD beta<min(alpha,1/2); MC alpha,beta>1/2; coexistence 0<alpha=beta<1/2 in the positive-rate interior; CRIT_ALPHA alpha=1/2,beta>1/2; CRIT_BETA beta=1/2,alpha>1/2; CRIT_CORNER alpha=beta=1/2 is the multicritical phase-boundary junction; alpha=beta=0 is handled by the zero-rate boundary theorem; all critical pieces have finite-size corrections.
theorem.small_sizes: L=0 is the one-state chain; L=1 has two states and current alpha*beta/(alpha+beta) in the positive interior.
theorem.thermodynamic_scope: Phase and density statements are analytic all-parameter consequences; finite ledgers are regression sentinels and do not prove the limit.
theorem.zero_faces: alpha=0,beta>0 has empty absorbing state; beta=0,alpha>0 has full absorbing state; alpha=beta=0 has L+1 right-packed absorbing states (one per particle number), and the stationary set is the simplex on these absorbers with affine dimension L.
